name_input: MARVEL VINYLS LIMITED; MARVEL VINYLS LTD; Marvel Vinyls Ltd.; MARVEL VINYLS LIMITED (UNIT-III); MARVEL VINYLS LTD UNIT II; MARVEL VINYLS LTD; M/S MARVEL VINYLS LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page for MARVEL VINYLS LIMITED (slug 'marvel-vinyls-limited', G-73 Connaught Circus) reports "Total Shipments 326 Records detected", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-26". Exact export row quoted: "2026-02-26 | MARVEL VINYLS LIMITED. | TO ORDER | PVC LEATHER CLOTH(TEXTILE FABRIC LAMINATED WITH PVC)POLYSTER WOVEN FABRIC PA ADCOATED 1.50 MM X 2 METER X 20 MTR | MALANPUR ICD INMPR6, India | Jebel Ali, UNITED ARAB EMIRATES | 59031090 | BOL 1036465". Second export row: "2026-02-16 | MARVEL VINYLS LIMITED. | TO ORDER | PVC FLEXIBLE SHEET / FILM 750 MICRONS X960MM BLACK | TUGLAKABAD ICD INTKD6, India | Jebel Ali, UNITED ARAB EMIRATES | 39204300 | BOL 9715846". Third: "2026-02-09 ... MALANPUR ICD INMPR6, India | Jebel Ali, UNITED ARAB EMIRATES | 59031090 | BOL 9491862". Source counter: page states 326 total shipments; rows actually visible on the free page = 5 (3 exports to UAE, 2 imports of PVC resin from Mitsui Co. Ltd., Yokkaichi, Japan, HS 39041020, BOLs 7614492 and 7453259).
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved: web_search returned no results (searx connection refused) and the company site https://www.marvelvinyls.com/ failed with TLS error; zaubacorp and thecompanycheck returned HTTP 403. No domestic supply record seen in the sources actually read.
note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records, not by catalogue claims: recurring outbound lanes from MALANPUR ICD (MP) and TUGLAKABAD ICD to Jebel Ali, UAE, Feb 2026, HS 59031090 (PVC-coated textile fabric) and 39204300 (PVC film/sheet). Declared HS set (291733; 390410; 392049; 392190) does not match the observed export codes 59031090/39204300 — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; actual codes should be recorded as 59031090 and 39204300 (plus 39041020 on the import side). Note the same entity also imports PVC suspension resin from Mitsui Co., Ltd. (Japan) — i.e. it is a converter of imported resin into coated fabric, consistent with a manufacturer role. Domestic (India) supply activity is plausible given the Malanpur/Gwalior plant but is NOT evidenced in any source I could open, so it is marked unknown rather than declared_only or confirmed. Revenue and export volume figures: null — not public in the sources read; not estimated. Slug variants tried: 'marvel-vinyls-limited' (substantive, 326 records) and 'marvel-vinyls-ltd' (page loaded but zero records shown).
